SASBDB entry SASDKQ8  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDKQ8/)

Publication: Rational thermostabilisation of four-helix bundle dimeric de novo proteins
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-021-86952-2

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDKQ8/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
